x87-fault-probe-v9-metadata.status: x87 pending and newly raised exception characterization complete
x87-fault-probe-v9-metadata.limitations: Authored AOT and Intel host instructions only. Windows SEH captures hardware faults; an authored System V nonlocal frame captures explicit native callbacks. This does not implement Windows or PS4 guest exception delivery. Defined status, nonempty payloads, flags, fault instruction address and unaffected State compared. Guest last-IP/DP/FOP, reserved fields and undefined condition bits excluded; AMD Jaguar behavior unverified.

x87-load-bindings-v7-metadata.limitations: Authored AOT and Intel hardware only; no game bytes. Narrow floating and signed integer loads use scoped native SoftFloat conversions. x87-image-bindings-v5-metadata.status: experimental x87 image instruction characterization complete
x87-image-bindings-v5-metadata.limitations: Authored AOT only, with independent Intel hardware images and explicit AMD policy expectations. Runtime services select the profile, track pointer segments and validate a fully mapped RAM span. This is not a general guest memory-fault implementation or native Windows/PS4 exception delivery. No game bytes executed. Coherent x87 memory/arithmetic and MMX alias handling remain open.

independent_compare_c1.limitations: Authored native hardware only. FNINIT/FLD80 and a local 28-byte environment image initialize each case with independently selected C1; immediate PUSHFQ captures flags before any waiting instruction. No Remill, AOT, FXRSTOR-imported guest values or SEH in comparison path. Host backup is restored before returning. Intel host observation does not settle AMD Jaguar semantics.

policy_bits.0: image save pointers only when ES is set
policy_bits.1: legacy image segment selectors serialize as zero
policy_bits.2: instruction FDP updates only for a newly unmasked exception
policy_bits.3: instruction FOP updates only for a newly unmasked exception
policy_bits.4: comparison preserves C1 except on stack underflow; clear bit selects unconditional C1 clear
policy_bits.5: comparison preserves OF/SF/AF; clear bit selects zeroing these flags
policy_bits.32..63: explicit MXCSR supported-bit mask for images

retained_failures.metadata-v1: 116320 cases exposed C1 disagreement between unconditional clearing and this Intel CPU. Exact pointer/opcode fields and service contracts agreed. Earlier stack/fault fixtures always initialized C1 to zero and did not expose the disagreement.
retained_failures.metadata-v2: Fixture compilation rejected a duplicate comparison_profile local; no execution occurred. Fixed fixture declarations in v3, then tightened documented preserved C0/C2/C3 and FNINIT reset checks in v4.

limitations: Authored AOT only. No game code was executed or newly accepted.
Both pointer/opcode policies cross all four comparison C1/auxiliary-flag combinations: eight explicit profiles. 6029312 cases pass their selected contracts, not universal hardware equivalence.
232640 selected C1 policy deviations and 517208 selected OF/SF/AF policy deviations from this Intel host remain recorded and explained; overlapping categories must not be summed as unique cases.

Intel instruction documentation says to clear comparison C1, but both independent authored probes observe preservation except stack underflow. The independent environment setup uses no AOT, Remill or SEH.

AMD application documentation lists only ZF/PF/CF modified by these comparisons. The preserve-OF/SF/AF policy follows that document and is not verified on AMD Jaguar hardware. Neither profile choice resolves the separate unmasked-invalid comparison flag behavior uncertainty.

The same metadata helper now covers constants, exchange, register pop, unordered integer-flag comparison, raw transfers/sign/conditional and narrow loads. Other numeric producers remain unconverted. FNINIT resets external selector metadata after clearing saved pointers/opcode.

Earlier payload/fault regressions retain their original scope; their added metadata stubs do not claim independent metadata coverage. The new fixture checks exact PC/FOP, selector resets, call counts, profiles and compound ordering.

Full logical native pointers remain checked; hardware pointer comparisons retain the separately documented low32 limit. Undefined condition bits for ordinary stack producers remain excluded; comparison preservation and FNINIT reset are checked.
1379648 matched pending hardware/native faults do not establish PS4 exception delivery or native Windows guest unwind.
Numeric stores/arithmetic/FSCALE, MMX coherence and native import/callback/exception/control closure remain open.
